# A list sorts in place on every language: `sort()` by `<` -- numbers, strings
# and a unit -- and `sortBy(before)` stably by a function. A list copied into
# another binding keeps its order and its items when the first one is sorted,
# pushed to or cleared: Kotlin dropped the copy of a binding nothing wrote,
# whatever wrote the list it was copied from. testdata/list_sort.sngl is the
# interpreter's half.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '7 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '7 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '7 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '7 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import time "sngl:time"

struct Move {
    name string = ""
    level int = 0
}

func least[T ordered](xs list[T]) option[T] {
    if xs.length() == 0 {
        return null
    }
    var sorted = xs
    sorted.sort()
    return sorted[0]
}

func testSort(t test.Test) {
    var xs = [3, 1, 2, -5, 1]
    xs.sort()
    t.assert(xs == [-5, 1, 1, 2, 3])
    var words = ["pear", "apple", "pears", "fig", "Zebra"]
    words.sort()
    t.assert(words == ["Zebra", "apple", "fig", "pear", "pears"])
    var waits list[time.duration] = [2s, 500ms, 1s]
    var want list[time.duration] = [500ms, 1s, 2s]
    waits.sort()
    t.assert(waits == want)
}

func testSortByIsStable(t test.Test) {
    var moves = [
        Move{name="growl", level=1},
        Move{name="vine whip", level=3},
        Move{name="tackle", level=1},
        Move{name="leech seed", level=3},
        Move{name="sleep powder", level=2},
    ]
    moves.sortBy(func(a Move, b Move) => a.level < b.level)
    t.assert(moves.map(func(m Move) => m.name) == ["growl", "tackle", "sleep powder", "vine whip", "leech seed"])
}

func testOrderedGeneric(t test.Test) {
    var xs = [3, 1, 2]
    t.assert(least(xs) == 1)
    t.assert(xs == [3, 1, 2])
}

func testSortLeavesACopyAlone(t test.Test) {
    var xs = [3, 1, 2]
    var kept = xs
    xs.sort()
    t.assert(kept == [3, 1, 2])
}

func testSortByLeavesACopyAlone(t test.Test) {
    var xs = [3, 1, 2]
    var kept = xs
    xs.sortBy(func(a int, b int) => a < b)
    t.assert(kept == [3, 1, 2])
}

func testPushLeavesACopyAlone(t test.Test) {
    var xs = [3, 1, 2]
    var kept = xs
    xs.push(4)
    t.assert(kept == [3, 1, 2])
}

func testClearLeavesACopyAlone(t test.Test) {
    var xs = [3, 1, 2]
    var kept = xs
    xs.clear()
    t.assert(kept == [3, 1, 2])
}
